name: After § 4
requested_by: PPE, S&D, Renew, Verts/ALE, The Left
title: REPORT on the revision of the Framework Agreement on relations between the European Parliament and the European Commission
part_text: 4 a. Calls upon the Commission, in light of the revised agreement, and in its role as guardian of the Treaties, to renew its efforts to fulfil the obligation in Article 226 TFEU and facilitate the adoption of a regulation governing the exercise of the European Parliament's right of inquiry, which remains long overdue; expects the Commission to honour the principle of mutual sincere cooperation when assessing Parliament's proposals on the matter and cooperate in good faith with the European Parliament to resolve any outstanding issues;
